LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you join two or more sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  In purposive groups, identify the conjunctions since, so, nor, yet, for, unless, although, though, in a text,  Construct sentences on proper use of leisure time using conjunctions. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication- AAC (residual speech/ digital devices with text-to-speech application/point/sign/write) to construct sentences,  Fill in blanks in sentences using conjunctions. Learners with manipulation difficulties could be purposively grouped/ paired/ individually to write/ stamp/ mount

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

and share their crossword puzzles on various social media platforms.
